sections.normalized_html:
If we follow the graph from left to right, we can see that:

  • For [MATH: x\in(-2,2)] the graph rises

  • For [MATH: x\in(2,5)] the graph falls

  • For [MATH: x\in(5,7)] the graph is flat

  • For [MATH: x\in(7,9)] the graph rises

Therefore, we conclude that:

  • The function is strictly increasing on the intervals where it always rises: [MATH: (-2,2)] and [MATH: (7,9).]

  • The function is increasing on the intervals where it never falls: [MATH: (-2,2)] and [MATH: (5,9).]
